action_args.content: Mayor Sarah Jenkins announced that all city buses will be completely free of charge on Saturdays and Sundays starting next month.
City Council member David Chen voiced support for the pilot program, citing potential environmental benefits.
Local Business Coalition president Elena Vance praised the initiative for increasing foot traffic to downtown shops.
Taxpayers Alliance spokesperson Tom Bradley expressed concern regarding budget allocation, arguing the estimated $4.2 million shortfall might eventually lead to higher municipal property taxes.
